shared_budget_review.cause: Changing between direct ORCA and SDK requests bypassed additional-science permission or extra-start counting. SDK-to-SDK also lacked the additional permission guard.
shared_budget_review.fix_scope: Store reservation checks only; cumulative reservation floor derives retained Attempts and InternalCall parent order, preserving initial direct multi-Step semantics. Unbindable internal parent history refuses new reservation. No old Run is rewritten.
shared_budget_review.intermediate_fixture_failure: shared-orca-budget-final has six fixture failures before reservation/recovery: legacy fixture used H2 outside the existing H2O/CH4 contract. Fixture changed to valid water; production whitelist unchanged.

timing_discrepancy.resolution: Unexplained timing difference in retained records; both values preserved without choosing or inferring an explanation.

limitations: The default suite started with v37 and five source files changed while it ran. Per-module import timing was not recorded; neither a uniformly v37 suite nor a final-candidate full suite can be asserted.
The default freeze records 62 production/lock/config paths, not test file snapshots. Fresh targeted gate records include relevant test hashes.
JUnit groups overlap and are not added into a synthetic total. The OPI managed test is skipped in the unit group and separately passed under its explicit real-worker switch.
The development driver 62-test group has retained JUnit but no standalone matching .log file; the missing log is represented as null. These tests were added after default-suite collection.
Default skips: real model 139, real container 22, real ORCA 16, Windows symlink privilege 1. These are not passes.
The default suite emitted one StarletteDeprecationWarning concerning httpx/TestClient.
The Store safety fix and two native-validator fixes are after the eighth and final live reservation; only offline regression validates those fixes. No additional live budget was used.
Unit and synthetic tests do not demonstrate a completed natural-language scientific workflow or scientific qualification. Real development failures are reported separately.

The 138-test gate had stable source hashes during its run; the final two native validator changes happened afterward. Their final 271-test gate validates the affected native/managed/observation boundary; no single final-candidate full-suite result exists.

recommendation.reason: Both default-suite failures have red/green closure. The five during-suite source changes and two later native-validator changes have scoped regression, including the final shared-budget and native-admission groups. Do not repeat the full suite without a new unresolved concern; explicitly preserve that the final frozen candidate has not had a complete default-suite rerun.

opi_native_admission_review.cause: Prepared XYZ validation accepted OPI terminal whitespace but native XYZ validation still required raw N+2 lines and the analytic profile read suffix blank rows as atoms.
opi_native_admission_review.fix: Native atom-count validation trims only terminal whitespace in a local validation view; profile reads exactly the already validated atom rows. Source bytes/hash and Request bindings are unchanged; interior blanks, extra frames/atoms and malformed coordinates remain rejected.
opi_native_admission_review.probe_scope: Offline revalidation of retained real OPI output through current structure and native admission; developer-authored HF input and temporary condition binding, no new preparation/model/ORCA/Docker and no autonomous success claim.
opi_native_admission_review.error_scope: The production native entry rejected the terminal whitespace first. The profile IndexError was reproduced only by a direct offline function test; neither is asserted to be the historical live007 exception.
